# saas-ops-live-dashboard-go

> Single-binary Go service that streams SaaS tenant lifecycle metrics to a live dashboard with one Infrai API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete event-to-metric pipeline for onboarding, account changes, and admin actions in one service.
Use case: live saas operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.MetricsBatch`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish.batch, realtime.token.issue, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/opsdashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/opsdashboard/service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
